def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A solid row divides top and bottom panels.
    sep_r = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_r is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_r], grid[sep_r + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        bg = max(set(x for row in top + bottom for x in row),
                 key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in top + bottom))
        out = []
        for r in range(n):
            out.append([
                9 if top[r][c] != bg or bottom[r][c] != bg else 3
                for c in range(w)
            ])
        return out

    # A solid column divides left and right panels. Transform the right panel:
    # its common background stays as-is; the other color is highlighted.
    sep_c = next((c for c in range(w)
                  if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_c is not None:
        left_w = sep_c
        right_w = w - sep_c - 1
        n = min(left_w, right_w)
        right = [[grid[r][sep_c + 1 + c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
        vals = [x for row in right for x in row]
        bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
        colors = set(vals)
        other = next((x for x in colors if x != bg), bg)
        return [[3 if x == other else (5 if len(colors) > 1 else bg)
                 for x in row] for row in right]

    return grid
